The '''Thickwood tree''' was a type of [[Tree/Legends|tree]] that evolved on [[Kubindi/Legends|Kubindi]]. Due to the high amount of solar radiation, the thickwood tree had very thick radiation-absorbent bark. They were home to a wide range of bark-burrowing insects that the native [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] used as a food source.<ref name="AJ10" />
